results.name: Amigo Auto Repair

wrong_claims.claim: Listing is Loc8NearMe only, rating 'not shown', 12 reviews, and 'Only mirror listings exist, about a dozen reviews, nothing since 2022'
wrong_claims.what_is_true: A real Google Business Profile exists for Amigo Auto Repair at 1100 Somerset St B: 4.5 stars from 20 reviews, unclaimed ('Claim this business', 'Add website' prompts). Reviews run to roughly 3 years ago, not 'nothing since 2022'.

Reviews are mixed: alongside praise for cheap, friendly work the Google snippets include a sharply negative review, and the visible recent review (about 3 years ago) alleges a $4,800 engine quote that another shop diagnosed as an alternator.

results.notes: Operating confirmed: Google shows the shop open, 'Closes 6 PM', phone (732) 448-9009, and the Loc8NearMe mirror carries the same address, hours (Mon-Fri 8-6, Sat 8-4) and the 'hard to find' comment plus Spanish-language reviews. No website found in search, and Google's own profile shows an 'Add website' prompt, so the no-website and no-online-quote issues hold. The GBP-claim opportunity is still valid but must be restated as claiming an existing unclaimed profile with 20 reviews, not creating one from mirrors. Scores stay sensible (evidence could arguably rise to 4 now that a real Google profile with 20 reviews is observable).

results.name: Above and Beyond Child Care
results.notes: Re-verified on Google Maps: 'Above and Beyond', 4.5 from 8 reviews, child care agency, 201 S 3rd Ave, (732) 545-5437, website field 'hpct-cae.org', and a visible 'Claim this business' prompt - so the unclaimed-profile and temple-link issues hold. A review about a month old criticises inconsistent enforcement of the contagious-illness policy, matching the record. Temple page confirms 8am-5pm Mon-Fri year round, director Sharon Raven, fax, and the director@aboveandbeyondkids.com email. A DNS lookup on aboveandbeyondkids.com returns ENOTFOUND, so the email domain is indeed dead - no own website or working domain. Licence 090900112 and the alleged 7am-6pm state-listing hours could not be re-verified (childcarenj.gov returns 403). Scores reasonable.

The sitemap lists /before-and-after-photos and /gallery (labelled PHOTOS and VIDEOS in the nav); there is no /videos URL in the sitemap.

results.notes: Live re-check at 390 px: document scrollWidth 768 vs viewport 390, hero paragraph cut mid-sentence, and the header REQUEST ESTIMATE / BOOK APPOINTMENT buttons sit at x=445-580, i.e. off-screen; the floating BOOK AN APPOINTMENT button is cut on the left by an accessibility widget. Mobile issue holds. JSON-LD is a single WebSite node (no LocalBusiness/AutoBodyShop); meta description is the booking-widget sentence; robots.txt sets search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes and points to the sitemap. Carwise shop-specific estimate and appointment URLs are in the nav, matching the bookable=3 assessment. Google listing re-opened: 4.5, Auto body shop, 'Book online' action, 184 Woodbridge Ave, (732) 572-4447 - review count not shown in the limited view, so the 179 figure stays unverified. Scores are reasonable as they stand.

results.name: LX Factory Barber Studio
results.notes: Booksy page re-opened: 5.0 with a review counter now reading 961-962 (record said 960 - live counter drift, not an error of substance); 'No walk-ins' stated; 'Venue Health and Safety Rules' still list employee masks, client masks and social distancing; four bookable barbers (Alex Maia, Jeremy Ramos, Roberto Gonzalez, Carlos Arruda) confirmed. Price menu confirmed as seven items from $30 to $55 (haircut $40, haircut+beard $45, seniors $30, beard trim or shave $30, shape-up+beard $35, premium haircut+hot towel $50, premium $55). results.name: Matecki's Service Center

results.name: Bronson & McNamara Memorial Home

wrong_claims.what_is_true: The BestProsInTown page (legacy 'bronson-and-guthlein-funeral-home' slug, but titled 'Reviews for Bronson & McNamara Memorial Home' and naming John McNamara and Chris) shows 3 reviews, all 5-star, the newest from March 2026. The Google review count could not be read.

results.notes: Site re-checked: only a WebSite JSON-LD node (no LocalBusiness), no office hours anywhere (only 'Available 24/7'), title/meta do name funeral, cremation and Milltown, footer '© 2026', address 152 North Main Street, phone (732) 828-0151 as tel links. At 390 px the header offers a 'Contact Us' button and a 'Traducir al Espanol' toggle, with no click-to-call in the sticky bar - so the missing-sticky-call-button issue holds. /contact-us has a Name/Email/Phone/Message form; /plan-online is a long pre-planning form with no scheduling; the General Price List is an external my.gather.app page; robots.txt only blocks obituary sub-paths, flowers, payments and trees. Only the review count needed correcting; scores left as recorded, though gap_size 4 is a touch generous for a site with pricing pages, an obituary feed and a pre-plan form - 3 would be defensible.

results.name: Ava Landscapes LLC

wrong_claims.what_is_true: The Google Maps entry for Ava Landscapes, 391 Main St #103, Spotswood, (908) 309-6990, is labelled 'Permanently closed'. The advertised domain avalandscapes.com still returns a bare '404 - Page not found!' page, and the newest third-party reviews I could date are from 2021 (BestProsInTown) and 2015/2013 (Angi); no 2024-2026 activity was found.

results.notes: The 404 claim is confirmed directly (https://avalandscapes.com/ serves an unbranded '404 Page not found!' with zero links), and BestProsInTown still shows Mon-Sat 8-5, card acceptance, owner Fred and crew, and a June 2021 review praising call-back speed - so the supporting details in the record are right. What is wrong is the premise: Google marks the business permanently closed. A closure flag can be user-suggested, so treat this as 'hold, verify by phone before any pitch' rather than a live prospect; the recorded scores should not be used for ranking.

data_gaps: childcarenj.gov provider detail page (licence 090900112) returns HTTP 403, so the state record, its 7am-6pm hours and the state-assisted-care note could not be re-verified for Above and Beyond Child Care.
homeadvisor.com and bbb.org both return HTTP 403, so Ava Landscapes' 4.9/34 HomeAdvisor figures and its BBB accreditation status were not re-read directly.
Google Maps limited view does not display review counts: the 179-review figure for Acme Auto Body and the review count for Advanced Martial Arts remain unverified.
Google review dates render as relative text ('3 years ago', 'a month ago'), so exact newest-review dates for Amigo Auto Repair and Above and Beyond are approximate.
Only the first page of Google review snippets was read; full review sets (Amigo, Above and Beyond, Matecki's) were not paged through.
